name: university-timetable-management
description: University data management, hybrid timetable generation, constraint solving and AI-assisted timetable editing as an offline-first Windows desktop application.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n renderer,electron -c cyan,magenta "npm:dev:renderer" "wait-on tcp:5173 && npm run dev:electron"
scripts.dist: npm run prepare:win && npm run icon && npm run build:renderer && electron-builder --win nsis --x64
scripts.pack:dir: npm run prepare:win && npm run icon && npm run build:renderer && electron-builder --win --dir
